title: Ghost kitchen internal accounting web app (Excel-matching logic): auth, CRUD, calculations, dashboards, and printable reports

requirements.text: Implement secure user access for the internal accounting app using Internet Identity, with the ability to run as a single-business-user system now while remaining future-ready for roles/permissions.

quotes:
Secure login
* Single business user is fine (future-ready for roles)

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users cannot access any accounting data screens
Authenticated users can log in/out via Internet Identity
Backend endpoints that read/write accounting data reject unauthenticated callers
Authorization logic is centralized so adding roles later does not require rewriting every endpoint

requirements.text: Create persistent backend data models and CRUD APIs for Expenses, Sales/Revenue, COGS, Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods to replace the existing Excel storage while keeping data entry fields aligned with the spreadsheet columns.

quotes:
Relational database with tables such as:

* Expenses
* Sales
* COGS
* Categories
* Vendors
* Payment Methods

acceptanceCriteria: Expenses records store: date, categoryId, vendorId, description, amount, paymentMethodId
Sales/Revenue records store: date, grossSales, platform percentages (by platform), and netProfit (or the raw fields needed to compute it exactly like Excel)
COGS records store: date, item, quantity, cost, vendorId
Categories/Vendors/Payment Methods are stored as editable master data with stable IDs
CRUD APIs exist for each entity (create, list with basic filtering/sorting, update, delete)
Data is persisted in canister stable storage so it survives upgrades (migration file only added if/when required by state changes)

requirements.text: Build form-based desktop-optimized UI for entering and editing Expenses, Sales/Revenue, and COGS with clean inputs and dropdowns, including validation and a table view for reviewing/editing existing entries.

quotes: All data is entered through clean forms with dropdowns.

acceptanceCriteria: Expenses form includes: Date, Category dropdown, Vendor dropdown, Description, Amount, Payment Method dropdown
Sales/Revenue form includes: Date, Gross sales, per-platform percentage inputs (e.g., DoorDash, Uber Eats), and Net profit for the day (entered or computed based on the preserved Excel logic)
COGS form includes: Date, Item, Quantity, Cost, Vendor dropdown
Each section provides a list/table view with edit/delete actions
Basic validation prevents invalid numbers and missing required fields
All user-facing text is in English

requirements.text: Add master-data management screens to create/update/delete dropdown values for Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods, and ensure these dropdowns are used across all entry forms.

quotes: Dropdown lists must be editable (categories, vendors, payment methods).

acceptanceCriteria: Dedicated UI pages exist to manage Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods
Changes to master data are immediately reflected in data entry forms without redeploying
Backend prevents deleting master data that is in use (or provides a safe handling strategy such as soft-delete/archiving)

requirements.text: Implement automatic calculations for category totals, monthly totals, annual summaries, profit & loss statements, margins, and platform fees, and ensure the results match the existing Excel formulas 1:1 by supporting a clearly defined, testable set of formulas and expected outputs.

quotes: All calculations must match my existing Excel logic exactly.

acceptanceCriteria: System computes: category totals, monthly totals, annual summaries, P&L, margins, and platform fee impacts (based on provided platform percentages)
Calculation results are reproducible and consistent for the same input data
A documented place exists in the codebase to define/adjust the formula logic (so it can be aligned to the spreadsheet), without changing unrelated UI/CRUD flows
Automated tests (backend and/or frontend) validate calculations against at least one set of sample inputs/expected outputs derived from the Excel spreadsheets once provided

requirements.text: Create a main dashboard with KPIs and time-window performance views (current day, current month, last 3/6/12 months), including color-coded indicators (green profitable, red loss / margin below threshold).

quotes:
A main dashboard showing:

* Total profit
* Total expenses
* Profit margin
* COGS
* Monthly performance at a glance
* Color-coded indicators for gains and losses

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays Total profit, Total expenses, Profit margin, and COGS for the selected time window
User can switch between current day, current month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months
Values are color-coded: green for profitable/positive, red for loss/negative or margin below threshold (threshold is configurable)
Dashboard loads data from backend APIs and updates when new entries are added

requirements.text: Implement report views that match the spreadsheet-style layout logic and are print-friendly: daily summaries, monthly expense reports, monthly profit & loss statements, 3/6/12-month reports, and annual summaries, with PDF/export-ready printing via browser print styles.

quotes:
Ability to generate and print:

* Daily summaries
* Monthly expense reports
* Monthly Profit & Loss statements
* 3-month, 6-month, and 12-month reports
* Annual summaries

Reports must be:

* Print-friendly
* PDF/export-ready
* Audit-friendly

acceptanceCriteria: Each requested report type is accessible from a Reports section with date/month/year selectors as appropriate
Reports render in a clean, table-based accounting layout suitable for printing
Print CSS ensures readable typography, proper page breaks where reasonable, and hides non-report navigation controls during printing
Users can print to PDF using the browser’s print dialog and get a clean output

requirements.text: Apply a consistent, clean, professional accounting UI theme optimized for desktop: neutral gray/slate base, clear typography, readable numeric tables, and consistent green/red semantics for positive/negative performance.

quotes:
Clean, professional accounting look
* Neutral gray/slate base
* Green for profit / positive values
* Red for loss / negative values
* Clear tables and readable numbers
* Optimized for desktop use
* Print-friendly layouts

acceptanceCriteria: All primary screens (Dashboard, Expenses, Sales/Revenue, COGS, Master Data, Reports) share a consistent layout, spacing, and typography
Neutral gray/slate palette is used across the UI with green/red reserved for performance semantics
Tables align numbers consistently (e.g., right-aligned amounts) and use clear headings
Print views retain the same visual structure while removing app chrome

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only when upgrading existing stable state requires it
Frontend must not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable by the system; compose those components instead
Use English for all user-facing text
Preserve the user’s Excel calculation logic 1:1; do not change calculation behavior—only translate it into code once the formulas/outputs are provided
nonGoals: Add third-party authentication beyond Internet Identity
